title: component-index.json
description: The page writer's component index, written by the site build (#4: site/src/components/library.ts, buildComponentIndex) to site/dist/component-index.json and read by `news components` and `news component <name>`. One entry per component in name order. `line` is the one-line entry for the cached prompt prefix (ADR 0001: at most 24 tokens each, 4,000 in all, counted as ceil(UTF-8 bytes / 3)). The detail fields are optional: the site build adds them from each component's spec.ts (#4, #7); until then `news component` says they are missing.

tokens.description: Estimated tokens of all lines joined by newlines

name.description: PascalCase; the name the page writer calls in OpenUI Lang

line.description: The one-line entry, "Name — purpose — data shape" (spec.ts `index`)

props.description: Optional. JSON Schema 2020-12 of the component's props (from its zod schema)

dataShape.description: Optional. Which references each prop takes, in words (spec.ts `dataShape`)

example.description: Optional. One realistic call in OpenUI Lang, references only (spec.ts `example`)
